limits: Only the returned recent window, at most 200 rows; counts are not complete history totals. No historical rule conditions are inferred from current rules.
Delivery status is the current projection in this read, not a delivery snapshot at data availability. Null observations are not zero and field units are not inferred.

Existing backend historical timestamp handling remains millisecond-based. This frontend preserves and validates supplied precision but does not claim trigger-time market replay; the daily link opens current research.
